title: Gaussian gauge fixing gives a closed positive finite-cylindrical BRST Hilbert complex

gauge_fixed_complex.gauge_factor: L2(R^m,gamma_m) for normalized standard Gaussian measure, tensored with Lambda(C^m)
gauge_fixed_complex.differential: d_gamma=sum_j partial_(chi_j) wedge e_j on the Gaussian Sobolev domain is closed and nilpotent
gauge_fixed_complex.hodge_operator: d_gamma d_gamma*+d_gamma* d_gamma is the Ornstein--Uhlenbeck number operator
gauge_fixed_complex.gap_and_ranges: Its kernel is the constants in degree zero and its spectrum is at least one on the orthogonal complement; all differential ranges are closed
gauge_fixed_complex.cohomology: After tensoring with the K1422 invariant reduced block, H0 equals H_N^U(1), higher cohomology vanishes, and the induced pairing is positive and nonzero
gauge_fixed_complex.boundary: Gaussian measure is not translation invariant. This is a gauge-fixed finite-cylindrical Hilbert complex, not a unitary bare gauge representation, source-derived Faddeev--Popov measure or continuum quantum BRST theorem
